detail.longDescription:
Guardio protects every part of your digital life: your devices, identity, accounts, and activity, so you can browse, shop, text, and bank online with confidence.

But it’s more than just alerts. Guardio gives you a clear picture of your online security, showing where your personal information is exposed, what’s already protected, and what steps you can take to stay safer.

Whether it’s a scam link, leaked password, or a suspicious message, Guardio detects threats early and helps you stop them before they cause harm.


What Guardio Protects You From
Phishing in emails, texts, fake websites and social media
Scam links, AI-generated traps, and personalized attacks
Leaked personal information and account monitoring
Identity theft, fraud, and financial scams
Weak spots like missing 2FA or unmonitored accounts


Guardio Features Included in the App
Real-time alerts when your personal info is exposed (Guardio uses accessibility permission in order to monitor the sites you visit and warn you when accessing malicious sites)
Email protection to scan for phishing and scam attempts
Identity monitoring for up to 5 email addresses
An easy-to-understand overview of your security status
Guidance to fix issues and stay protected
Critical Security Alerts when severe threats are detected
Sync across mobile and desktop for full coverage
24/7 customer support via email
VIP security specialist support available on select plans
Why Guardio
Guardio is built for real life, covering the way you actually live and browse. It’s protection that works quietly in the background, keeps you informed, and helps you take control of your digital safety.
Guardio doesn’t just block threats, it helps you avoid them.


Plans
Individual: Protection for 1 person
Duo: Full protection for you + 1 other
Family: Covers up to 5 people, each with their own device protection
VIP: Premium support and one-on-one security guidance

All Guardio plans include proactive protection, identity monitoring, scam detection, and full cross-device coverage.
You can cancel anytime. Your protection stays active until the end of your billing cycle.


Part of Guardio’s Complete Protection Suite
This mobile app is part of Guardio’s full security platform.
Pair it with the Guardio browser extension on Chrome or Edge for continuous protection across desktop and mobile.


Need Help?
Email us at support@guard.io
